title: A High-Speed CCD Photometer
version: Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific 99, 877–886, August 1987, DOI 10.1086/132053.
lineage: Original paper scan provided by NASA ADS. Shares authors with the 1987 DAS design report, and reports separate photometer operation.

passages.locator: pp. 877–879, abstract, Table I and Fig. 1
passages.note: Stover and Allen identify the standard Lick system as the source for most parts of the photometer. A 6502-based CCD controller sends pixel data over a serial link to an LSI-11/73 running UNIX.
